crossRefs.note: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son…
I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
Now Yahweh, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to…
Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore…
Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of…
Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far, their silver and…
“But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

people.name: Jesus
